description: Five reviewed retail regression scenarios. Golden queries use raw facts and normalized dimensions; expected values are never sent to the model. This small suite does not establish general answer accuracy.
evidence_request: Query the warehouse and return one total row of evidence for the requested measures, without a daily or monthly breakdown. Label monetary units as cents or USD in evidence column names and cite the evidence in your brief answer.

cases.question: Across all channels and divisions, what were total merchandise net sales before returns and completed order count for the current UI period? Exclude tax and shipping.
cases.golden_sql: SELECT sum(net_sales_cents) AS sales_cents, count(*) AS orders FROM fact_transaction WHERE date_key BETWEEN 20250105 AND 20251227
manual_review: Answer uses current UI dates, all-business scope and sales-before-returns basis.
Headline values correspond to the cited result, including any displayed rounding.

cases.question: For Web purchases of Footwear only, what were total merchandise net sales before returns and sold units during the current UI period? Exclude tax and shipping, and retain both filters.
cases.golden_sql: SELECT sum(s.net_sales_cents) AS sales_cents, sum(s.quantity) AS units FROM fact_sales_line s JOIN fact_transaction h ON s.transaction_key=h.transaction_key JOIN dim_channel ch ON h.channel_key=ch.channel_key JOIN dim_sku sku ON s.sku_key=sku.sku_key JOIN dim_style st ON sku.style_key=st.style_key JOIN dim_category cat ON st.category_key=cat.category_key JOIN dim_department dep ON cat.department_key=dep.department_key JOIN dim_division div ON dep.division_key=div.division_key WHERE h.date_key BETWEEN 20250105 AND 20251227 AND ch.channel_name='Web' AND div.division_name='Footwear'
manual_review: Both Web and Footwear filters remain in the query and answer.
Sales and units use line grain, without header fan-out or all-business substitution.

cases.question: Ignore the default UI period for this question: for March 1 through March 31, 2024 inclusive, give total merchandise net sales before returns and completed order count across all channels and divisions. Exclude tax and shipping.
cases.golden_sql: SELECT sum(net_sales_cents) AS sales_cents, count(*) AS orders FROM fact_transaction WHERE date_key BETWEEN 20240301 AND 20240331
manual_review: The explicit March 2024 dates override the 2025 UI scope.
The narrative does not describe the default UI period as the effective query period.

cases.question: Apply my latest correction in this conversation. What were total merchandise net sales before returns and sold units for that corrected slice? Exclude tax and shipping.

prior_messages.content: Please look at Web Apparel purchases in January 2025.
We have discussed display preferences. No measured numerical findings are supplied in this fixture.
Correction: use Mobile app purchases of Footwear from July 1 through July 31, 2025 inclusive instead. This replaces the earlier Web, Apparel and January filters.
Understood. I will use the corrected scope for your next analysis.

cases.golden_sql: SELECT sum(s.net_sales_cents) AS sales_cents, sum(s.quantity) AS units FROM fact_sales_line s JOIN fact_transaction h ON s.transaction_key=h.transaction_key JOIN dim_channel ch ON h.channel_key=ch.channel_key JOIN dim_sku sku ON s.sku_key=sku.sku_key JOIN dim_style st ON sku.style_key=st.style_key JOIN dim_category cat ON st.category_key=cat.category_key JOIN dim_department dep ON cat.department_key=dep.department_key JOIN dim_division div ON dep.division_key=div.division_key WHERE h.date_key BETWEEN 20250701 AND 20250731 AND ch.channel_name='Mobile app' AND div.division_name='Footwear'
manual_review: Recent user correction survives the long older context.
Answer uses Mobile app, Footwear and July 2025, without stale Web/Apparel/January filters.
The constructed prior conversation is context, not previously measured evidence.

cases.question: How much incremental merchandise revenue did loyalty membership cause in January 2025? Establish whether the available Summit Field data can identify this causal effect; do not replace causal lift with member-versus-nonmember differences. Cite the relevant metric/model documentation, and explain the evidence needed if this cannot be identified.
manual_review: Explicitly abstains from a numeric causal-effect estimate because membership is not randomized and no credible identification design is provided.
Does not relabel descriptive member differences as incremental lift.
Names an appropriate missing experiment/holdout or defensible quasi-experimental design and cites actual documentation.
Any descriptive figures, if included, are measured and clearly separated from causal claims.
